learner_operation: Identify which of four displayed numbers satisfy a scripted special set: intersect numerical class (integer/rational/real), sign, and zero inclusion.

fixed_features.feature: Four elementary real candidates, one scripted target, easy workload
fixed_features.justification: Canonical example ce8a56c1 and all 11 practice questions require four independent class/sign/zero decisions.

fixed_features.feature: Five complete subset options for radio; Boolean fields for checkbox
fixed_features.justification: All three captured radio sources use five choices, while checkbox fields express the same finite subset. These are observed response contracts.

fixed_features.feature: Signed targets from the seven observed source profiles
fixed_features.justification: Conservative variation within tutorial 8215 definitions; target identity, qualifying positions and count are not fixed.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Every four-bit mask; each position may qualify or fail
answer_roles.observed: All 16 masks tested in every radio target and both restored checkbox targets; old checkbox targets sampled at none/all boundaries.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Change target holding all four candidates fixed
answer_roles.observed: Q0+, R0+, Q0-, Q-, Z0+ change masks 5,7,9,8,1 in both response contracts.

answer_roles.role: Radio correct subset and choice position
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any subset may be correct and occupy any bank position; distractors derived separately
answer_roles.observed: Four random distinct incorrect subsets plus correct subset, then shuffled; tests parse every offered subset and score all positions. No fixed answer-producing label or count.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Within-class magnitude changes preserve membership; roots and reducible fractions must be classified
answer_roles.observed: 1/2 to 3/4 preserves mask 5; 430 exact simplification/conversion identities checked.

coverage.case: Restored source response families and banks
coverage.result: All 11 sources, including all 3 radio banks, reproduced; source 59f3318f missing key/solution independently inferred II only and explicitly flagged.

coverage.case: All qualifying identities and counts in revised domains
coverage.result: 154 controlled records; all masks 0..15 under each radio target and each restored checkbox target.

Five distinct masks 5,4,12,6,8 survive; three radio and two checkbox records. Z0+ radio masks 4 and 6 differ; R0+ checkbox masks 12 and 8 differ. No tested fixed-position complete response answers its repeated template.

counterfactuals.change: Hold candidates [0,sqrt2,1/2,-3] fixed; change Q0+ to R0+, Q0-, Q-, and Z0+
counterfactuals.expected: Reconsider class, sign, and zero inclusion; masks 5,7,9,8,1
counterfactuals.observed: Visible prompt and per-candidate solution classifications change consistently; every offered correct/wrong response exercised by native grader; rendered Q0+/R0+ pairs show changed decisions in both response modes.
counterfactuals.justification: Tutorials 8214 and 8215 independently define these intersecting rules.

counterfactuals.change: Keep Q0+ and other candidates fixed; replace 1/2 by 3/4
counterfactuals.expected: Both are positive noninteger rationals; preserve mask 5 despite display, IDs and shuffled bank changing.
counterfactuals.observed: Both modes retain identical qualifying positions; updated visible value and solution, native correct/wrong outcomes, and actual UI renders checked.
counterfactuals.justification: Tutorial 8214 defines rational membership by ratio of integers; magnitude within this sign/class does not matter.
